title: Flutter Developer Intern
description:
We're Hiring: Flutter Developer Intern

**Company:** Torchit Electronics Private Limited  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat — Work from Office  
**Internship Duration:** 6 Months  
**Opportunity:** Potential Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance  
**Application Email:**

About Torchit

Torchit is an assistive technology company building innovative, technology-driven solutions to empower persons with disabilities. Our work combines AI, mobile applications, smart hardware, and accessibility-focused design to make education, mobility, information, and everyday activities more accessible.

We believe in the philosophy: **“By the Differently Abled, For the Differently Abled.”**

At Torchit, you will work on real products and practical engineering challenges rather than just training assignments. Your contribution can help make technology more inclusive and accessible.

Role Overview

We are looking for a passionate and technically strong **Flutter Developer Intern** who is eager to build high-quality Android and iOS applications using Flutter and Dart.

The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of programming fundamentals, hands-on experience with Flutter, and the ability to convert UI designs into functional, responsive mobile applications. You should be comfortable learning new technologies, debugging issues, integrating APIs, and collaborating with a product and engineering team.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to move beyond basic tutorials and contribute to production-oriented mobile applications, including AI-powered and assistive technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
* Build responsive, reusable, and well-structured UI components from design references.
* Integrate REST APIs and handle JSON data, authentication, network requests, and error states.
* Implement application navigation, state management, form validation, and data handling.
* Work with backend services, local storage, and third-party SDKs as required.
* Debug application crashes, fix UI issues, and improve performance across different devices.
* Collaborate with designers, backend developers, and product team members to deliver features.
* Participate in code reviews and follow clean coding practices, version control, and Git workflows.
* Test applications, identify bugs, and ensure a consistent user experience across screen sizes.
* Explore integrations involving AI features, Bluetooth-connected devices, accessibility tools, and assistive technology where relevant.
* Maintain technical documentation and provide regular progress updates.

Required Technical Skills

**Core requirements**

* Working knowledge of Flutter and Dart.
* Understanding of object-oriented programming and fundamental data structures.
* Experience building at least one Flutter application or a meaningful personal/academic project.
* Understanding of widgets, layouts, navigation, and responsive UI development.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON parsing, asynchronous programming, and error handling.
* Basic understanding of state management, such as Provider, Riverpod, or Bloc.
* Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
* Ability to troubleshoot issues independently and explain technical decisions.

**Good to have**

* Experience with Firebase Authentication, Firestore, or push notifications.
* Knowledge of SQLite, Hive, shared preferences, or other local storage solutions.
* Familiarity with Android Studio, VS Code, and mobile application debugging.
* Exposure to app testing, performance optimization, and Play Store deployment.
* Basic knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive UI design.
* Interest in AI integrations, IoT, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), or hardware-connected mobile applications.

Who Should Apply?

* Students pursuing B.E., B.Tech, BCA, MCA, or a related computer science or IT qualification.
* Recent graduates with demonstrable Flutter development skills.
* Candidates who have built personal projects, college projects, prototypes, or open-source contributions.
* Self-driven learners who enjoy solving technical problems and taking ownership of assigned tasks.
* Candidates available to work from our Ahmedabad office for the internship duration.

**Important:** Practical skills, project quality, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn matter more than academic marks or certificates.

What We Expect From You

* A strong willingness to learn and improve every day.
* Ownership of assigned tasks, deadlines, and code quality.
* Ability to understand requirements and break them into manageable development tasks.
* Clear communication and a collaborative mindset.
* Willingness to receive feedback, debug difficult issues, and improve existing code.
* Genuine interest in building reliable mobile applications that solve real-world problems.

What You Will Gain

* Hands-on experience developing real mobile application features.
* Exposure to the complete mobile development lifecycle, from UI implementation to testing and debugging.
* Practical experience with API integrations, state management, Git, and collaborative development.
* Opportunities to explore AI-enabled products and assistive technology ecosystems.
* Mentorship, technical feedback, and exposure to product development practices.
* A performance-based opportunity for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO), subject to business requirements and evaluation.

Selection Process

* **Application Screening:** Review of resume, technical skills, and projects.
* **Technical Assessment:** Flutter/Dart fundamentals, programming logic, and a practical development task.
* **Technical Interview:** Discussion of projects, architecture, APIs, debugging, and problem-solving.
* **Final Discussion:** Availability, internship expectations, and joining timeline.

Candidates may be asked to demonstrate or explain code from their submitted projects.

How to Apply

Send your resume and the following details to **nikhilmaddula@mytorchit.com**:

* Full name and contact details
* Current qualification and college, if applicable
* GitHub profile or portfolio link
* Links or brief descriptions of Flutter projects
* Current location and availability to join
* Confirmation of availability for a work-from-office internship in Ahmedabad

**Email Subject:** Application – Flutter Developer Intern – [Your Name]

**Build technology that makes a difference. Join Torchit and help create a more accessible world.**

Pay: From ₹8,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Software Architect (iOS)
description:
**Software Architect (iOS) | Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Work from Office**

**Experience:** 7+ years

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

**About Vagaro**

Vagaro is a global leader in cloud-based business management software for the salon, spa, beauty, fitness, and wellness industries. Our product-led platform helps businesses manage scheduling, payments, marketing, and operations in one place.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on iOS Architect to own the architecture, quality, and scalability of the Vagaro Pro and Vagaro customer iOS apps. You will set technical direction for the iOS platform, lead the modernization of a large production codebase, and raise the engineering bar across the mobile team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the iOS app architecture: modularization, layering, state management, navigation, and dependency injection.
* Define and drive the iOS technical roadmap, including the Objective-C to Swift and UIKit to SwiftUI migration.
* Author architecture decision records (ADRs) and design docs; review and approve significant designs and critical PRs.
* Design API contracts with backend teams covering REST, pagination, error handling, offline sync, and versioning.
* Set and enforce targets for crash-free users, hangs, launch time, app size, and memory usage.
* Lead root-cause analysis for production crashes and incidents, and drive fixes to closure.
* Define the iOS testing strategy (unit, UI, snapshot, integration) and automation coverage gates per release.
* Own app security: Keychain usage, certificate pinning, token handling, and OWASP MASVS alignment.
* Improve CI/CD, Xcode build performance, the release train, phased releases, and feature flag usage.
* Mentor iOS engineers, run architecture reviews, and take part in technical hiring.

**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of software engineering, including 5+ years building native iOS apps shipped at scale.
* 2+ years in an architect, tech lead, or principal role owning architecture decisions.
* Expert in Swift, with strong working knowledge of Objective-C for legacy code and hands-on SwiftUI and UIKit interop.
* Strong in Swift Concurrency (async/await, actors) and Combine, with a solid grasp of GCD and the app lifecycle.
* Expert in MVVM, Clean Architecture, the Coordinator pattern, and modular project structure using Swift Package Manager.
* Experience with Core Data or SwiftData, Keychain, URLSession, Codable, and protocol-based dependency injection.
* Proficient with Xcode build settings, schemes, code signing, provisioning, and CocoaPods/SPM dependency management.
* Testing with XCTest, XCUITest, and snapshot testing; performance work using Instruments, MetricKit, and launch-time and memory optimization.
* Experience with Firebase Crashlytics, APNs, and App Store Connect (TestFlight, phased release, review guidelines).
* Mobile CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps and Fastlane.
* Clear written communication for design docs, ADRs, and RCA reports.

**Good to Have**

* Working knowledge of Android or Kotlin Multiplatform.
* Experience with WKWebView/React screens embedded in native apps and bridge design.
* Mobile payments or POS experience (card readers, Tap to Pay on iPhone, PCI considerations).
* Accessibility (VoiceOver, WCAG) and localization at scale.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS products.

**Why Join Us**

* 5-day work week with a flexible schedule
* 15 paid leaves + 11 holidays, with leave encashment
* Comprehensive family medical insurance and maternity benefits
* Annual bonus and recognition programs
* Learning resources, tech sessions, gaming zones, Fun Fridays, and cultural events

Shape the architecture and direction of a product used at scale. If you want ownership, influence, and room to grow, apply now and let's build something great together.

title: Senior Software Engineer I/II (iOS)
description:
### **Job Description**

**Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer I/II (iOS)

**Department:** Technology – Security

**Reports to:** Software Engineering Manager

### **Required experience: 4+ years.**

**Location:** Ahmedabad, India-Remote

  

### **Company Introduction**

As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We’re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today.

We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don’t take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace for the last 5 years (2021–2025) with a rating of 4.3 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor, and 4.4 stars out of 5 on AmbitionBox. Our team members love our competitive benefits, including remote work options, comfortable work-life balance, paid time off (PTO), personal and family health insurance options, paid family leave, and development/training opportunities.

**Job Role**
------------

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer I/II (iOS) to own the full lifecycle of our native iOS applications, from design and development through release and maintenance. You will build secure, high-quality, scalable apps for iPhone and iPad using Swift and SwiftUI, following modern architectures such as MVVM and Clean Architecture.

You will work on features that power Genea’s platform, including mobile credentials, access control, and connected IoT devices over Bluetooth Low Energy, NFC, and Apple Wallet pass provisioning. Working closely with UI/UX designers, software testers, and backend engineers, you will bring expertise in reactive programming, networking, multithreading, memory management, and mobile security, and help drive continuous improvement across our agile process and CI/CD pipelines.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Actively participate in the entire iOS application lifecycle, from concept and design through development, testing, release, and maintenance.
* Design, implement, and maintain features on our iOS app platform using Swift and SwiftUI.
* Conceptualize and build apps that work well across all Apple devices and screen sizes, including iPhone and iPad.
* Develop features that communicate with IoT hardware such as access control readers, locks, and sensors over Bluetooth Low Energy (Core Bluetooth) and NFC (Core NFC).
* Implement and maintain Apple Wallet integrations, including PassKit and in-app pass provisioning for mobile access credentials.
* Build robust networking layers to integrate with REST APIs and backend services, handling authentication, error states, retries, and offline scenarios.
* Implement security best practices to protect user data and credentials, including Keychain, Secure Enclave, encryption, and certificate pinning.
* Implement and maintain push notifications (APNs / FCM) and background tasks.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, software testers, backend engineers, and hardware teams to ensure app presentation and functionality meet requirements and Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines.
* Write clean, testable code; review peers’ code and rectify errors before app releases.
* Profile and optimize app performance, memory usage, and battery consumption.
* Own and improve iOS CI/CD pipelines, code signing, provisioning profiles, and TestFlight / App Store release processes.
* Monitor app reviews, crash reports, and analytics to identify areas for improvement.
* Recommend and implement process and technology improvements.
* Provide training, mentorship, and support to team members.

  

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* Strong proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI, with working knowledge of UIKit and interoperability between the two.
* Practical knowledge of iOS app architecture, design, implementation, and release, including MVVM, Clean Architecture, and modular app design.
* Hands-on experience with RxSwift; familiarity with Combine and Swift Concurrency (async/await, actors) is a plus.
* Strong grasp of Swift language features, including protocols, generics, closures, and higher-order functions (map, filter, reduce, compactMap).
* Dependency management with CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager, and strong troubleshooting skills for resolving dependency conflicts.
* Experience building apps that integrate with IoT devices.
* Knowledge of Bluetooth Low Energy using Core Bluetooth, including scanning, pairing, GATT services, background modes, and connection reliability.
* Experience with NFC using Core NFC (tag reading/writing and NFC-based access use cases).
* Experience with Apple Wallet and PassKit, including in-app pass provisioning and mobile credential workflows.
* Solid understanding of networking: REST APIs, URLSession, asynchronous request handling, JSON parsing, authentication (OAuth, tokens), and offline storage/sync.
* Security background: Keychain, Secure Enclave, biometric authentication (Face ID / Touch ID), data encryption, certificate/SSL pinning, and awareness of OWASP Mobile Top 10.
* Good understanding of multithreading using GCD, OperationQueue, and Swift Concurrency.
* Experience with background tasks and background execution modes on iOS.
* Knowledge of iOS memory management (ARC, retain cycles, weak/unowned references) and performance profiling with Instruments.
* Experience with push notifications using APNs and Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM).
* Experience with local storage such as Core Data, Realm, or SQLite.
* Familiarity with agile development techniques and CI/CD for iOS (e.g., Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Bitrise, or Xcode Cloud), code signing, and App Store Connect / TestFlight.
* Experience writing unit and UI tests using XCTest.
* Solid understanding of SDLC and agile methodologies.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4+ years of experience in native iOS application development using Swift.
* Portfolio of iOS apps published on the App Store, with evidence of contributions across the full development lifecycle.
* Experience in any domain is welcome; experience with security, access control, IoT, or hardware-connected products is highly preferred.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly.

**Competencies**
----------------

* **Diversity** – Shows respect and sensitivity for cultural differences; Educates others on the value of diversity; Promotes a harassment-free environment; Builds a diverse workforce.
* **Ethics** – Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values.
* **Adaptability** – Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
* **Attendance/Punctuality** – Is consistently at work and on time; Ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent; Arrives at meetings and appointments on time.
* **Design** – Generates creative solutions; Translates concepts and information into images; Uses feedback to modify designs; Applies design principles; Demonstrates attention to detail.
* **Oral Communication** – Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; Listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions; Demonstrates group presentation skills; Participates in meetings.
* **Problem Solving** – Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.
* **Professionalism** – Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.
* **Quality** – Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.
* **Quantity** – Meets productivity standards; Completes work in timely manner; Strives to increase productivity; Works quickly.
* **Safety and Security** – Observes safety and security procedures; Determines appropriate action beyond guidelines; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and materials properly.
* **Teamwork** – Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.
* **Technical Skills** – Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares expertise with others.
* **Written Communication** – Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

**Perks & Benefits**
--------------------

✨ **Work Your Way:** Enjoy a flexible working environment that suits your lifestyle.

✨ **Time Off:** 24 days of PTO and 10 holidays to unwind and pursue your passions.

✨ **Comprehensive Leave Options:** Including maternity, paternity, adoption, wedding, and bereavement leaves to support you during important life events.

✨ **Health & Safety First:** Benefit from family health insurance and personal accident coverage beyond your CTC.

✨ **Top Workplace Honors:** Celebrated as a Top Workplace from 2021 to 2025.

✨ **Balanced Workweek:** Embrace a balanced life with our 5-day work schedule.

description:
**Position -**  Android Developer  
**Experience:** 2+ Years  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Android Developer with 2+ years of professional experience in developing, maintaining, and optimizing Android applications. The ideal candidate should have strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java, hands-on experience with Android SDK and Jetpack libraries, and practical knowledge of **Jetpack Compose** for building modern, responsive, and user-friendly mobile applications.

The candidate should understand Android application architecture, state management, API integration, and performance optimization, with the ability to write clean, scalable, and maintainable code while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality Android applications using Kotlin and Java.
* Build modern, responsive, and reusable user interfaces using **Jetpack Compose** and Material Design principles.
* Work with Android SDK, Android Jetpack libraries, and modern Android development practices.
* Implement and maintain application architecture using MVVM or MVP design patterns.
* Manage UI state, recomposition, and side effects effectively in Jetpack Compose.
* Implement navigation between screens using Navigation Compose and manage dynamic lists using LazyColumn and LazyRow.
* Integrate RESTful APIs and manage local data using SQLite and Room Database.
* Implement Firebase services, push notifications, and other relevant third-party integrations.
* Use ViewModel, Kotlin Coroutines, and Flow/StateFlow for efficient state and asynchronous data management.
* Identify, debug, and resolve application issues while optimizing performance and responsiveness across Android devices.
* Follow clean code principles, reusable component design, and appropriate error-handling practices.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and QA engineers to deliver reliable mobile applications.
* Participate in code reviews, application testing, sprint planning, and other Agile development activities.
* Ensure application compatibility, usability, security, and quality across different Android versions and screen sizes.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 2+ years of professional experience in Android application development.
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java.
* Hands-on experience with Android SDK, Android Studio, and Jetpack libraries.
* Practical experience with **Jetpack Compose**, including:
* Composable functions and recomposition.
* State management using remember, mutableStateOf, and rememberSaveable.
* State hoisting and ViewModel-based state management.
* Side-effect APIs such as LaunchedEffect and DisposableEffect.
* Navigation Compose and efficient list rendering using LazyColumn and LazyRow.
* Good understanding of MVVM/MVP architecture and Android design patterns.
* Experience integrating REST APIs and working with JSON data.
* Knowledge of SQLite, Room Database, and local data persistence.
* Familiarity with Kotlin Coroutines, Flow/StateFlow, and asynchronous programming.
* Experience with Firebase services and push notifications.
* Knowledge of Git and version control practices.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of mobile UI/UX principles, application lifecycle, and performance optimization.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, testable, and efficient code.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an Agile development environment.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with Material 3 theming and reusable UI component development.
* Familiarity with dependency injection tools such as Hilt.
* Knowledge of Android UI testing, including Jetpack Compose testing.
* Experience using Android Studio tools, including Layout Inspector, for debugging and performance analysis.
* Understanding of modern Android development best practices and accessibility considerations.

Preferred Qualities

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to code quality.
